summary: E2E validation of Comprobante de Pago (Payment Proof) feature on /inscripcion. Backend (5/5 pytest) and Frontend (3/3 Playwright flows) all pass. One-time warning logic, file upload flow, admin column, 'Ver' link, and CSV export columns all working correctly.

issues: React hydration console warnings: <span> incorrectly nested inside <select>/<tr>/<tbody> in some admin components. Non-blocking but generates 4 console errors per load and may cause SSR/hydration issues.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate and fix the React hydration warnings (<span> not allowed as direct child of <select>/<tr>/<tbody>) in admin components — these are pre-existing and unrelated to the comprobante feature, but worth cleaning up.

(Optional/cosmetic) Task spec references button label 'Exportar Todas' but the UI shows 'Exportar Todo' (data-testid='btn-exportar-todo'). Behavior is correct; verify if main agent wants to rename to match the PRD wording.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend file /app/backend/server.py is 1776 lines — recommend modularizing into routers (registrations, admin, payments, gallery, etc.) for maintainability.

/api/registrations/{id}/upload-comprobante has no authentication. Any client can upload a comprobante to any registration ID if they know it. Consider gating by admin token OR a short-lived signed token returned at registration creation. Current behavior is intentional per the public inscripcion flow, but worth flagging.

Uploaded files are served publicly with no auth. The filename includes a uuid suffix so guessing is hard, but treat as security-sensitive (PII in payment screenshots). Consider serving via authenticated endpoint or signed URLs.
create_registration does not explicitly set tiene_comprobante/comprobante_url on the new doc; relies on Pydantic defaults — works correctly today but explicit defaults would be safer.
MercadoPago endpoint has dead code after early return (lines 715+ in server.py) — should be removed.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_-prefixed registrations during E2E run; both deleted via DELETE /api/admin/registrations/{id} after tests. Pytest tests also self-clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_comprobante_flow.py covers: create-registration default state ('pendiente', no comprobante), upload-comprobante updates state to 'completado' + tiene_comprobante=true + file is publicly accessible via returned URL, 404 on bad id, 400 on bad mime type. GET /api/registrations returns dict {registrations:[...]} not a list — handled in tests. Admin login endpoint returns 'access_token'.
verified_flows: Admin login returns access_token; GET /api/registrations returns tiene_comprobante & comprobante_url ✅
Submit without file (1st click) → window.alert fires + [data-testid=comprobante-warning] visible + no navigation ✅
Submit without file (2nd click) → registration created (estado_pago=pendiente) + navigates to /confirmacion-preinscripcion?registration_id=... ✅
Submit with PDF attached → registration created, comprobante uploaded, navigates to confirmation ✅
CSV export ('Exportar Todo' button) includes 'Adjuntó comprobante' (Sí/No) and 'URL Comprobante' columns ✅
